classification.difficultyReason: Find each exterior angle by subtracting its supplied interior angle from 180 degrees, then state or verify the taught 360-degree total.

content.prompt: Work out the sizes of the exterior angles of each of these shapes.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base, all three side extensions and interior-angle arcs. Coordinates reconstruct the stated angles; source lengths are unspecified.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles: lower left 46°, top 86°, lower right 48°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied interior angles are visible.

answer.worked:
Each interior angle and its exterior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}E_{\text{top}}&=180^{\circ}-86^{\circ}=94^{\circ}\\E_{\text{lower right}}&=180^{\circ}-48^{\circ}=132^{\circ}\\E_{\text{lower left}}&=180^{\circ}-46^{\circ}=134^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Irregular pentagon with five side extensions, one right-angle square and four interior-angle arcs. Vertex directions derive from the supplied angles; side lengths are illustrative.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise from upper left: 90°, 125°, 83°, 130°, 112°. Their sum is 540°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied interior angles are visible.

answer.worked:
Each interior angle and its exterior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$. Clockwise from the upper-left vertex:
$$\begin{aligned}E_1&=180^{\circ}-90^{\circ}=90^{\circ}\\E_2&=180^{\circ}-125^{\circ}=55^{\circ}\\E_3&=180^{\circ}-83^{\circ}=97^{\circ}\\E_4&=180^{\circ}-130^{\circ}=50^{\circ}\\E_5&=180^{\circ}-112^{\circ}=68^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral with matching parallel-side arrows, two upper right-angle squares, two lower angle arcs and four side extensions.
spec.mathematics: Left and right sides are parallel. Upper angles are 90°; lower-left angle is 55° and lower-right angle is 125°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied interior angles and geometric marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Each interior angle and its exterior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}E_{\text{upper left}}&=180^{\circ}-90^{\circ}=90^{\circ}\\E_{\text{upper right}}&=180^{\circ}-90^{\circ}=90^{\circ}\\E_{\text{lower right}}&=180^{\circ}-125^{\circ}=55^{\circ}\\E_{\text{lower left}}&=180^{\circ}-55^{\circ}=125^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

children.prompt: What is the sum of the exterior angles for each of the shapes above?

answer.worked: The exterior angles of each polygon sum to $360^{\circ}$.
